project_proposal: 2.2.3. Develop a Web-based 3D Object Building and Virtual Space Management System Design and implement an interactive, game‑like object placement system within the CityU digital twin, enabling users to select 3D objects from a predefined library and place them onto the virtual environment’s floor in real time. Users should be able to choose the virtual environment they want to work with, e.g. Podium. The system should provide intuitive controls for positioning, rotating, and scaling objects, ensuring accurate alignment with the scene’s terrain and existing structures. The goal is to create an engaging, user‑friendly experience that encourages exploration and creativity without requiring any 3D modelling skills or coding skills. While the primary interaction will be single‑user during placement, the final system will support networked viewing, allowing users to explore others customised virtual spaces online.
